verdict.rationale: The public Models page lists per-token pricing ($42 per Btok / $0.042 per Mtok, charged on input only, output free) with no sales contact, and the same page covers every served model on the shared endpoint (jev-latest, jev-preview, versioned jev-1.13.0). Missing for 10: an explicit per-model price breakdown confirming that each current model (including preview) carries this rate, and independent corroboration of the published prices.
